meta.name: testing
meta.description: Smart contract testing with Foundry — unit tests, fuzz testing, fork testing against live state, and invariant testing. What to test, what to skip, and what LLMs commonly get wrong.

copy.tagline: 自动测试智能合约,上线前揪出漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做区块链开发,需要确保智能合约没有漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Automate smart contract testing to catch vulnerabilities before deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing blockchain smart contracts and need to ensure they are bug-free.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Foundry 帮你做智能合约测试：写单元测试、做模糊测试、对真实链上状态做分叉测试，还有不变量测试；同时会告诉你该测什么、跳过什么，以及 LLM 常犯的错。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 测试智能合约、编写测试用例或检查合约漏洞时就会触发。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude helps test smart contracts with Foundry: writing unit tests, fuzz testing, fork testing against live chain state, and invariant testing. It also flags what to test, what to skip, and common LLM mistakes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to test a smart contract, write test cases, or check for vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Write Foundry unit tests for my contract
say_en.note: Generates test files and run instructions

say_en.text: Fuzz my contract to find bugs
